INSERT INTO t_seat_inventory (program_id, seat_id, ticket_category_id, sell_status, reservation_id, order_number, version, price_in_cents, sale_version, create_time, edit_time, status) VALUES
(#{programId}, #{seat.seatId}, #{seat.ticketCategoryId}, #{seat.sellStatus}, NULL, NULL, 0, #{seat.priceInCents}, #{saleVersion}, NOW(), NOW(), 1)
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE ticket_category_id = IF(sell_status = 1, VALUES(ticket_category_id), ticket_category_id), price_in_cents = IF(sell_status = 1, VALUES(price_in_cents), price_in_cents), sale_version = IF(sell_status = 1, VALUES(sale_version), sale_version), edit_time = NOW()
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_seat_inventory WHERE program_id = #{programId} AND status = 1

SELECT i.seat_id, i.ticket_category_id, i.price_in_cents, i.sell_status, i.reservation_id, i.order_number, o.user_id, otu.ticket_user_id, req.request_fingerprint, o.expire_time AS reservation_expire_time FROM t_seat_inventory i LEFT JOIN d_order o ON o.order_number = i.order_number AND o.status = 1 LEFT JOIN d_order_ticket_user otu ON otu.order_number = i.order_number AND otu.seat_id = i.seat_id AND otu.status = 1 LEFT JOIN t_order_request req ON req.reservation_id = i.reservation_id WHERE i.program_id = #{programId} AND i.status = 1 ORDER BY i.seat_id
